name: Computer Control
description: Let the agent see and operate your desktop: read the screen through the accessibility tree, click, type, scroll, press shortcuts and open applications, with your permission.
author: PAI

changelog.summary: First release: computer control for Linux desktops (accessibility tree, click, type, keys, scroll, drag, apps).
features: computer.observe: the active window's accessibility tree (AT-SPI2) with roles, names, positions and states, plus an optional screenshot

computer.click / long_press / type / key / scroll / swipe: a semantic accessibility action when the element has one, otherwise pointer and keyboard events through the desktop's remote-desktop portal (Wayland) or XTEST (X11)
computer.apps.list / launch / foreground, and computer.status which says exactly what is missing and how to fix it
Consent per plugin for screen and input; element ids are valid only within the observation that issued them

capabilities.description: Say whether computer control is ready and what is missing (accessibility bus, permissions, input path) with how to fix it. Never asks the user for anything.

Look at the screen: the active application and window, and the accessibility tree of its controls (role, name, text, position, state, an id per element). Optionally a screenshot (PNG, base64) for what the tree does not expose. Element ids are valid only until the next observation. Result fields app, screen, tree and screenshot are JSON.

max_nodes.description: At most this many tree nodes, 1-500 (default 150).

capabilities.confirmationReason: PAI wants to look at what is on your screen.

capabilities.description: Click an element (element_id) or a point (x, y). Uses the element's own accessibility action when it has one, otherwise real pointer events at its centre. Verify the effect with computer.observe.

element_id.description: An element id from the latest computer.observe (preferred over coordinates).

observation_id.description: Optional: the observation the element id came from; refused with stale_observation if the screen was observed again since.

x.description: Horizontal pixel of the latest observation (used when there is no element_id).

y.description: Vertical pixel of the latest observation (used when there is no element_id).

capabilities.confirmationReason: PAI wants to operate your computer for you (click, type, scroll). You can stop it at any time.

capabilities.description: Type text, into an element (it is focused first; a text field is filled directly) or into whatever has focus. Newline presses Return. Up to 500 characters.

clear_first.description: Replace the field's content instead of adding to it (default false).

capabilities.description: Press a key or shortcut, xdotool style: ctrl+l, alt+Tab, Return, Escape, F5, ctrl+shift+t. Write the plus key as 'plus'.
